rationale: The agent processed an exchange for the thermostat without first confirming the change with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The user’s request also included a conditional keyboard exchange (clicky, RGB backlight, full-size) with a fallback to only exchange the thermostat if no suitable keyboard exists. The agent neither confirmed availability nor processed or declined the keyboard exchange with an explanation, leaving the request partially unaddressed. Additionally, the reply asserts specifics (e.g., “black, Google Assistant-compatible version” and refund handling) without showing supporting tool outputs. While the tools indicate the agent looked up the user and order and executed an exchange on the correct order, the lack of prior confirmation and incomplete handling of the keyboard condition mean the request was not completed per policy.
